name: VOiCES: Voices Obscured in Complex Environmental Settings
description: The VOiCES (Voices Obscured in Complex Environmental Settings) corpus is an acoustic dataset designed to advance far-field automatic speech recognition and robust speaker verification in noise. Recorded by SRI International and Lab41 (In-Q-Tel) across four real reverberant rooms with background distractors (television, music, room babble), it plays back 3,903 clean source speech files through a motorized rotating loudspeaker recorded over twelve microphones per room, generating 120 hours of distant audio per channel across 300 speakers.
